name: M15 50-pip round-number single-cross follow and fade screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen legacy backlog cites an unspecified edition at pages 81, 143 and 167 for round-number/pivot context
source_references.supports: Wiley verifies current bibliographic metadata only. The cited pages were not opened and do not establish a cost-aware 50-pip M15 FX crossing rule.

research.evidence_summary: No inspected source establishes this rule. The fixed 50-pip grid is an original compact operationalization of weak book context; both response signs are falsified symmetrically.

feasibility.rationale: All six symbols are non-JPY FX pairs sharing a 0.0001 pip definition; only exact-decimal OHLC, causal M15 bars, supported fills/stops and same-day exits are required, but V2 compatibility remains unconfirmed.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes through t; elapsed gaps do not reset ATR, but crossing bars t-1 and t must be physically adjacent
preprocessing: Parse stored decimal price strings without binary-floating rounding for grid comparisons; pip_size=0.0001 and round_grid=0.0050 exactly for every declared non-JPY pair
Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require 15 consecutive unique valid candles per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite/positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates invalidate aggregation
Compute observed-sequence TR from previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, freeze through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: A fixed 50-pip spacing may be arbitrary across volatility regimes
Six correlated symbols/four cells are not independent

hypothesis.behavior: A completed M15 close moving strictly across exactly one 50-pip grid level may continue through that price landmark or fade back.
hypothesis.mechanism: Continuation could reflect clustered stops/order flow; fading could reflect liquidity concentration and temporary overshoot.
works_when: The exact decimal grid is behaviorally salient
One response sign survives both holds and costs
falsifiable_predictions: Both hold cells for one response mode are positive normal/doubled
The 60-minute center is positive in both UTC halves and at least three symbols
Both cells survive common five-date removal

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) through t-1 over valid observed true ranges
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal t; require finite positive

definitions.name: grid_levels
definitions.timing: Exact decimal constants; never binary-float comparison

definitions.name: crossed_levels
definitions.timing: Both endpoints must themselves not belong to G

definitions.name: cross_direction
definitions.formula: sign(close_t-close_{t-1}) only when exactly one crossed level exists; otherwise no event
definitions.timing: Known at completed t close; equality, endpoint-on-grid and multiple-level moves are excluded

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: cross_direction for FOLLOW_CROSS and -cross_direction for FADE_CROSS

entries.long_condition: eligible t AND exactly one crossed level AND endpoints off-grid AND ((cross_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_CROSS) OR (cross_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FADE_CROSS)) AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible t AND exactly one crossed level AND endpoints off-grid AND ((cross_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_CROSS) OR (cross_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FADE_CROSS)) AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes<=15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at final M1 chart/bid close of completed t; V2 applies resolved/fallback spread, commission/slippage. Entry candle cannot trigger new stop; management starts next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
Endpoint on grid, zero move, or zero/multiple strictly crossed levels is no event

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers bid, short executable ask; adverse gaps fill at worse executable open with costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; valid due bar resolves STOP_LOSS before TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry matures after 15:00; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns isolated portfolio; same-timestamp symbols within cell size from common pre-entry equity so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap shared across four portfolios
risk.leverage: Use lower of stop-risk size/V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol/six total; four cells independently track all state

experiment.baseline: fixed exact 50-pip single-cross/one-ATR stop; FOLLOW_CROSS; hold=60
robustness_tests: Report all four cells and retain full breadth ledger
Report symbols and UTC-midpoint halves; midpoint close belongs first half
For each mode center hold=60 remove five best normal-cost London dates from both hold cells; require both normal/doubled net R positive
For both cells use eligible London weekdays including zeros and 10000 circular five-date bootstrap resamples seed 2026015; center lower bound must exceed zero
Mode advances only if hold=60 center and hold=30 neighbor both pass
costs: Use resolved/fallback spread, commission, slippage at each fill
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical crossings
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 320 selectable R007-R015 cells, R008 diagnostics, and named round-number/pivot/crossing trials including I-30. Cross-batch promotion uses full ledger; incomplete IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless both holds positive normal/doubled
Reject if center non-positive either UTC half or fewer than three symbols positive each half
Reject if center fewer than 300 trades
Reject if five-date removal makes either cell non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound not above zero
Reject promotion on required-cell data failure
Never access holdout without explicit authorization for separately frozen version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
Using exact decimal arithmetic enumerate 0.0050 grid levels strictly between adjacent closes; require exactly one and both endpoints off-grid.
Map follow/fade and enter flat cells at signal close.
From next M1 process stop before due exit; fail only affected cells.
Publish four cells and full robustness/ledger rows.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: event-pair gap suppresses signal while elapsed gaps remain in ATR
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with shared exact grid features and isolated four-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 exact-decimal grid and M15/fill/result compatibility confirmation
